description: This file contains utility functions for splitting a string into tokens and adding valid tokens to a linked list.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits a string into tokens based on spaces and stores valid tokens into a linked list.

methods.name: addIfValid
methods.description: Adds the token to the list if it passes validation.

methods.name: isTokenValid
methods.description: Checks if a token is valid (non-empty).
